title: server.transcript.final
description: Settled normalised text of an utterance, in session time; it replaces every partial with the same segment_id.

segment_id.description: The partials and the final of one utterance share it.

session_start_ms.description: Session time (ms since the session started, backend clock) when the utterance started.

session_end_ms.description: Session time at the end of the recognised text; never before session_start_ms.

text.description: Normalised text, whichever STT path produced it (ADR-0008).

confidence.description: Recognizer score, when one was reported.
